claim: The 45° limit is sharp: 44.9° links, 45.1° does not.
derivation: The layout of flock.measure.group-heading-limit, with P4 heading 44.9° and Q4 heading 45.1°.
cos 44.9° = 0.708340 > cos 45° = 0.707107, so P4 links (E14): P is one cluster of 4, one group. cos 45.1° = 0.705872 < cos 45°, so Q4 does not link: Q1–Q3 and Q4 are strays. clusterCount = 1.
Unit headings: six (1, 0), one at 44.9° and one at 45.1°. Their sum is (7.414211, 1.414211), so directionalAgreement = 0.943485 (E12).
Every bird's nearest neighbour is 1 away: meanNeighbourDistance = 1 (E13).
Strays: Q1, Q2, Q3 and Q4, 4 of 8 birds: strayShare = 0.5 (E18). One group holding half the birds reads as one group (O1).
